definitions.explanation: A picture or design made by printing from a carved block or plate. Includes woodblock prints (mokuhanga), lithographs, and other printmaking techniques.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{美術|びじゅつ}で{版画|はんが}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made prints in elementary school art class.

examples.japanese: {浮世絵|うきよえ}は{日本|にほん}の{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{木版画|もくはんが}として{世界的|せかいてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Ukiyo-e is world-famous as a traditional Japanese woodblock print art form.

notes:
USAGE:
Common verbs: {版画|はんが}を{刷|す}る (to print), {版画|はんが}を{彫|ほ}る (to carve a print block).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木版画|もくはんが}: woodblock print
- {銅版画|どうはんが}: copperplate engraving
- {版画|はんが}{家|か}: printmaker
- {版画|はんが}{展|てん}: print exhibition

CULTURAL NOTE:
Printmaking is part of the standard Japanese elementary school art curriculum. Most Japanese people have experience carving and printing {版画|はんが} as children. Japanese woodblock printing ({浮世絵|うきよえ}) had a major influence on Western art, particularly Impressionism.
